items.name: Artifact_Intake.Detected_Objects
items.technical: object-detection: Text holds post-submit labels. Not a column that fills itself.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.External_Record
items.technical: integration: Needs a Connection the owner authorizes later. The column stores the external id or display text. The fetch is not generated by the schema step.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Extracted_Terms
items.technical: keyword: Not a column that fills itself. Text stores the Zia result of a post-submit call. The call is not part of this schema step.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Forecast
items.technical: prediction: Needs a trained Zia model. No column is generated. Not-yet-tried as a generated field.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Old_Crm_Record
items.technical: legacy-crm-link: Pre-Creator 5 record id (API type 23). Bigint column. The CRM connection is owner-later.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Old_Crm_Reference
items.technical: legacy-crm: Pre-Creator 5 display value (API type 22). Text column. The CRM connection is owner-later and is not created here.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Shelf_Code
items.technical: barcode: Creator builds the code from static text plus other fields. The column stores that payload. The renderer is not a Data Store type. At most two per form in Creator; this step does not enforce the cap beyond reporting the field.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Site_Location
items.technical: geolocation: Not a Creator field type. Latitude and longitude exist only inside Address (and Added/Modified Location). No geo column is invented for this token. If a source still says geolocation, it is reported unsupported.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Text_From_Image
items.technical: ocr: Text holds a post-submit Zia OCR result. Depends on the image living in Stratus. Not self-filling.

items.name: Artifact_Intake.Tone_Result
items.technical: sentiment: Same as keyword extraction: text holds a post-submit Zia result. Not self-filling.
